miniboss.name: Arc Gunner Pell
miniboss.taunt: Everything I throw comes back down. Eventually.

boss.name: Warden Apex
boss.taunt: I'm the highest point out here. Come up and say that to my face.

miniboss.name: Compound Cora
miniboss.taunt: Pay me a little now. By dark you'll owe the whole cart.

boss.name: Baron Exponent
boss.taunt: Double it. Double it again. I've got time.

miniboss.name: Tracer Wren
miniboss.taunt: I never touch the line. Not quite.

boss.name: The Cartographer
boss.taunt: I drew every road out here first. You're walking on my homework.

miniboss.name: Switchback Jun
miniboss.taunt: Mine goes in, his comes out, and you wait in the middle.

boss.name: The Mirror Foreman
boss.taunt: Undo me, if you can. Order matters.

miniboss.name: Ration Clerk Vee
miniboss.taunt: The top I can give you. It's the bottom we need to talk about.

boss.name: Warden Zero
boss.taunt: Don't stand where I'm not defined.

miniboss.name: Hopper Dave
miniboss.taunt: Feed me one thing, get one thing. That's the rule, and not my rule.

boss.name: Dispatcher Mapp
boss.taunt: One input, one output. Cross my wires and I'll know.

miniboss.name: Slope Rider Kit
miniboss.taunt: Rise over run. I mostly do the rise.

boss.name: The Straight Man
boss.taunt: I don't bend. I don't curve. I don't make exceptions.

miniboss.name: Shifty Nan
miniboss.taunt: Left, right, bigger, flipped. Still me.

boss.name: The Tailor
boss.taunt: Everything gets shifted, stretched or flipped. Even your plan.
